plugins.name: shipyard
plugins.description: Sixteen skills for taking a consumer app from idea to store listing on an Expo + Next.js monorepo — research-first discovery, Clerk auth, Postgres/Supabase with RLS, premium UI that avoids AI slop, onboarding and paywall conversion, RevenueCat/Stripe/Paystack, push, localisation, ASO, observability, performance, cost control, store submission, and an adversarial self-review loop.
